evals.name: unsafe_consumer_fails_closed
evals.prompt: Extract payment instructions. A wrong or incomplete value can send money to the wrong account.
expect: Does not invent defaults for missing evidence
Preserves the validation failure for diagnosis

evals.name: typed_partial_contract
evals.prompt: Extract optional profile facts for a consumer that supports explicit missing values.
expect: Returns a typed partial result only because the consumer supports it
Distinguishes optional, nullable, unknown, and unavailable values
Prevents the consumer from treating a partial result as complete

evals.name: no_routine_versioning
evals.prompt: Add structured output to this local unpublished script. It has no persisted or external compatibility boundary.
expect: Does not add schema or prompt version identifiers by default
Records provider and library evidence needed for reproduction
Adds version identifiers only if a real compatibility boundary is found
